# PLMR

> Independent engineering, drawing coordination and Türkiye-based technical sourcing for outdoor architectural systems and project-specific components.

PLMR is led by Aytuğ Kılınç, a civil engineer based in Türkiye.
Project scope, deliverables, responsibilities, timing and fees are agreed per enquiry.
System descriptions and illustrative deliverables are not evidence of completed client projects, manufacturing capacity or product certification.

## Services and contact
- [Engineering support](https://plmr.solutions/engineering-services): technical review and drawing coordination.
- [Technical sourcing](https://plmr.solutions/technical-sourcing-turkey): supplier search, technical questions and comparison support.
- [Components](https://plmr.solutions/custom-components-solutions): project-specific aluminium and steel component requirements.
- [Example deliverables](https://plmr.solutions/example-deliverables): explicitly illustrative review, drawing and sourcing outlines.
- [Outdoor systems](https://plmr.solutions/outdoor-systems): system families and project considerations.
- [Technical insights](https://plmr.solutions/technical-insights): project preparation and system selection articles.
- [About PLMR](https://plmr.solutions/about): background and working approach.
- [Contact](https://plmr.solutions/contact): project enquiry form with reference-image attachments and file-sharing links, plus direct email and a downloadable project brief.
- [Privacy](https://plmr.solutions/privacy): project correspondence and technical data.

Business email: aytugkilinc@plmrsolutions.com
Automation Studio is a future concept with no public demo or product release.

## Practical sourcing guide
- [Comparing supplier quotations](https://plmr.solutions/technical-insights/comparing-outdoor-system-quotations): a method for recording scope, evidence, exclusions and unanswered questions.
